function ase({taskId: t, onPhotoCapture: n, photos: r=[], onPhotoRemove: s}) {
    const [a,i] = v.useState(!1)
      , [o,l] = v.useState(null)
      , c = v.useRef(null)
      , m = v.useRef(null)
      , u = v.useRef(null)
      , h = async () => {
        try {
            const y = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({
                video: {
                    facingMode: "environment"
                }
            });
            l(y),
            i(!0),
            c.current && (c.current.srcObject = y,
            c.current.play())
        } catch (y) {
            console.error("Error accessing camera:", y),
            alert("Could not access camera. Please check permissions or use file upload instead.")
        }
    }
      , f = () => {
        o && (o.getTracks().forEach(y => y.stop()),
        l(null),
        i(!1))
    }
      , x = () => {
        if (c.current && m.current) {
            const y = m.current
              , N = c.current;
            y.width = N.videoWidth,
            y.height = N.videoHeight;
            const S = y.getContext("2d");
            if (S) {
                S.drawImage(N, 0, 0);
                const _ = y.toDataURL("image/jpeg", .8);
                n(t, _),
                f()
            }
        }
    }
      , b = y => {
        const N = y.target.files?.[0];
        if (N) {
            const S = new FileReader;
            S.onloadend = () => {
                const _ = S.result;
                n(t, _)
            }
            ,
            S.readAsDataURL(N)
        }
    }
      , g = y => {
        s && s(t, y)
    }
    ;
    return e.jsxs("div", {
        className: "space-y-2",
        children: [e.jsx("div", {
            className: "flex gap-2",
            children: !a && e.jsxs(e.Fragment, {
                children: [e.jsxs(W, {
                    type: "button",
                    size: "sm",
                    variant: "outline",
                    onClick: h,
                    "data-testid": `button-camera-${t}`,
                    children: [e.jsx(kv, {
                        className: "w-4 h-4 mr-1"
                    }), "Camera"]
                }), e.jsxs(W, {
                    type: "button",
                    size: "sm",
                    variant: "outline",
                    onClick: () => u.current?.click(),
                    "data-testid": `button-upload-${t}`,
                    children: [e.jsx(Zo, {
                        className: "w-4 h-4 mr-1"
                    }), "Upload"]
                }), e.jsx("input", {
                    ref: u,
                    type: "file",
                    accept: "image/*",
                    onChange: b,
                    className: "hidden",
                    "data-testid": `input-file-${t}`
                })]
            })
        }), a && e.jsxs(se, {
            className: "p-4 space-y-2",
            children: [e.jsxs("div", {
                className: "relative",
                children: [e.jsx("video", {
                    ref: c,
                    className: "w-full rounded-md",
                    autoPlay: !0,
                    playsInline: !0,
                    "data-testid": `video-preview-${t}`
                }), e.jsx("canvas", {
                    ref: m,
                    className: "hidden"
                })]
            }), e.jsxs("div", {
                className: "flex gap-2",
                children: [e.jsxs(W, {
                    type: "button",
                    size: "sm",
                    onClick: x,
                    "data-testid": `button-capture-${t}`,
                    children: [e.jsx(kv, {
                        className: "w-4 h-4 mr-1"
                    }), "Capture"]
                }), e.jsx(W, {
                    type: "button",
                    size: "sm",
                    variant: "outline",
                    onClick: f,
                    "data-testid": `button-cancel-camera-${t}`,
                    children: "Cancel"
                })]
            })]
        }), r.length > 0 && e.jsx("div", {
            className: "grid grid-cols-2 gap-2",
            children: r.map( (y, N) => e.jsxs(se, {
                className: "relative p-2",
                children: [e.jsx("img", {
                    src: y,
                    alt: `Photo ${N + 1}`,
                    className: "w-full h-32 object-cover rounded",
                    "data-testid": `img-photo-${t}-${N}`
                }), e.jsx(W, {
                    type: "button",
                    size: "icon",
                    variant: "destructive",
                    className: "absolute top-1 right-1 h-6 w-6",
                    onClick: () => g(y),
                    "data-testid": `button-remove-photo-${t}-${N}`,
                    children: e.jsx(pr, {
                        className: "w-3 h-3"
                    })
                })]
            }, N))
        })]
    })
}

function zn(t) {
    const n = Object.prototype.toString.call(t);
    return t instanceof Date || typeof t == "object" && n === "[object Date]" ? new t.constructor(+t) : typeof t == "number" || n === "[object Number]" || typeof t == "string" || n === "[object String]" ? new Date(t) : new Date(NaN)
}
function bi(t, n) {
    return t instanceof Date ? new t.constructor(n) : new Date(n)
}

    return isNaN(n) ? bi(t, NaN) : (n && r.setDate(r.getDate() + n),
    r)
}
function qi(t, n) {
    const r = zn(t);
    if (isNaN(n))
        return bi(t, NaN);
    if (!n)
        return r;
    const s = r.getDate()
      , a = bi(t, r.getTime());
    a.setMonth(r.getMonth() + n + 1, 0);
    const i = a.getDate();
    return s >= i ? a : (r.setFullYear(a.getFullYear(), a.getMonth(), s),
    r)
}

                    message: i.message
                }),
                s.dirty()) : i.kind === "jwt" ? Eie(n.data, i.alg) || (a = this._getOrReturnCtx(n, a),
                Mt(a, {
                    validation: "jwt",
                    code: vt.invalid_string,
                    message: i.message
                }),
                s.dirty()) : i.kind === "cidr" ? Mie(n.data, i.version) || (a = this._getOrReturnCtx(n, a),
                Mt(a, {
                    validation: "cidr",
                    code: vt.invalid_string,
                    message: i.message
                }),
                s.dirty()) : i.kind === "base64" ? kie.test(n.data) || (a = this._getOrReturnCtx(n, a),
                Mt(a, {
                    validation: "base64",
                    code: vt.invalid_string,
                    message: i.message
                }),
                s.dirty()) : i.kind === "base64url" ? Aie.test(n.data) || (a = this._getOrReturnCtx(n, a),
                Mt(a, {
                    validation: "base64url",
                    code: vt.invalid_string,
                    message: i.message
                }),
                s.dirty()) : nr.assertNever(i);
        return {
            status: s.value,
            value: n.data
        }
    }
    _regex(n, r, s) {
        return this.refinement(a => n.test(a), {
            validation: r,
            code: vt.invalid_string,
            ...tn.errToObj(s)
        })
    }
    _addCheck(n) {
        return new jo({
            ...this._def,
            checks: [...this._def.checks, n]
        })
    }

function Oie(t, n) {
    const r = (t.toString().split(".")[1] || "").length
      , s = (n.toString().split(".")[1] || "").length
      , a = r > s ? r : s
      , i = Number.parseInt(t.toFixed(a).replace(".", ""))
      , o = Number.parseInt(n.toFixed(a).replace(".", ""));
    return i % o / 10 ** a
}
class Xc extends On {
    constructor() {
        super(...arguments),
        this.min = this.gte,
        this.max = this.lte,
        this.step = this.multipleOf
    }
    _parse(n) {
        if (this._def.coerce && (n.data = Number(n.data)),
        this._getType(n) !== Kt.number) {
            const i = this._getOrReturnCtx(n);
            return Mt(i, {
                code: vt.invalid_type,
                expected: Kt.number,
                received: i.parsedType
            }),
            pn
        }
        let s;
        const a = new Pa;
        for (const i of this._def.checks)
            i.kind === "int" ? nr.isInteger(n.data) || (s = this._getOrReturnCtx(n, s),
            Mt(s, {
                code: vt.invalid_type,
                expected: "integer",
                received: "float",
                message: i.message
            }),
            a.dirty()) : i.kind === "min" ? (i.inclusive ? n.data < i.value : n.data <= i.value) && (s = this._getOrReturnCtx(n, s),
            Mt(s, {
                code: vt.too_small,
                minimum: i.value,
                type: "number",
                inclusive: i.inclusive,
                exact: !1,
                message: i.message
            }),
            a.dirty()) : i.kind === "max" ? (i.inclusive ? n.data > i.value : n.data >= i.value) && (s = this._getOrReturnCtx(n, s),
            Mt(s, {
                code: vt.too_big,
                maximum: i.value,
                type: "number",
                inclusive: i.inclusive,
                exact: !1,
                message: i.message
            }),
            a.dirty()) : i.kind === "multipleOf" ? Oie(n.data, i.value) !== 0 && (s = this._getOrReturnCtx(n, s),
            Mt(s, {
                code: vt.not_multiple_of,
                multipleOf: i.value,
                message: i.message
            }),
            a.dirty()) : i.kind === "finite" ? Number.isFinite(n.data) || (s = this._getOrReturnCtx(n, s),
            Mt(s, {
                code: vt.not_finite,
                message: i.message
            }),
            a.dirty()) : nr.assertNever(i);
        return {
            status: a.value,
            value: n.data
        }
    }
    gte(n, r) {
        return this.setLimit("min", n, !0, tn.toString(r))
    }
    gt(n, r) {
        return this.setLimit("min", n, !1, tn.toString(r))
    }
    lte(n, r) {
        return this.setLimit("max", n, !0, tn.toString(r))
    }
    lt(n, r) {
        return this.setLimit("max", n, !1, tn.toString(r))
    }
    setLimit(n, r, s, a) {
        return new Xc({
            ...this._def,
            checks: [...this._def.checks, {
                kind: n,
                value: r,
                inclusive: s,
                message: tn.toString(a)
            }]
        })
    }
    _addCheck(n) {
        return new Xc({
            ...this._def,
            checks: [...this._def.checks, n]
        })
    }
    int(n) {
        return this._addCheck({
            kind: "int",
            message: tn.toString(n)
        })
    }
    positive(n) {
        return this._addCheck({
            kind: "min",
            value: 0,
            inclusive: !1,
            message: tn.toString(n)
        })
    }
    negative(n) {
        return this._addCheck({
            kind: "max",
            value: 0,
            inclusive: !1,
            message: tn.toString(n)
        })
    }
    nonpositive(n) {
        return this._addCheck({
            kind: "max",
            value: 0,
            inclusive: !0,
            message: tn.toString(n)
        })
    }
    nonnegative(n) {
        return this._addCheck({
            kind: "min",
            value: 0,
            inclusive: !0,
            message: tn.toString(n)
        })
    }
    multipleOf(n, r) {
        return this._addCheck({
            kind: "multipleOf",
            value: n,
            message: tn.toString(r)
        })
    }
    finite(n) {
        return this._addCheck({
            kind: "finite",
            message: tn.toString(n)
        })
    }
    safe(n) {
        return this._addCheck({
            kind: "min",
            inclusive: !0,
            value: Number.MIN_SAFE_INTEGER,
            message: tn.toString(n)
        })._addCheck({
            kind: "max",
            inclusive: !0,
            value: Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER,
            message: tn.toString(n)
        })
    }
    get minValue() {
        let n = null;
        for (const r of this._def.checks)
            r.kind === "min" && (n === null || r.value > n) && (n = r.value);
        return n
    }
    get maxValue() {
        let n = null;
        for (const r of this._def.checks)
            r.kind === "max" && (n === null || r.value < n) && (n = r.value);
        return n
    }
    get isInt() {
        return !!this._def.checks.find(n => n.kind === "int" || n.kind === "multipleOf" && nr.isInteger(n.value))
    }
    get isFinite() {
        let n = null
          , r = null;
        for (const s of this._def.checks) {
            if (s.kind === "finite" || s.kind === "int" || s.kind === "multipleOf")
                return !0;
            s.kind === "min" ? (r === null || s.value > r) && (r = s.value) : s.kind === "max" && (n === null || s.value < n) && (n = s.value)
        }
        return Number.isFinite(r) && Number.isFinite(n)
    }
}

class Zc extends On {
    constructor() {
        super(...arguments),
        this.min = this.gte,
        this.max = this.lte
    }
    _parse(n) {
        if (this._def.coerce)
            try {
                n.data = BigInt(n.data)
            } catch {
                return this._getInvalidInput(n)
            }
        if (this._getType(n) !== Kt.bigint)
            return this._getInvalidInput(n);
        let s;
        const a = new Pa;
        for (const i of this._def.checks)
            i.kind === "min" ? (i.inclusive ? n.data < i.value : n.data <= i.value) && (s = this._getOrReturnCtx(n, s),
            Mt(s, {
                code: vt.too_small,
                type: "bigint",
                minimum: i.value,
                inclusive: i.inclusive,
                message: i.message
            }),
            a.dirty()) : i.kind === "max" ? (i.inclusive ? n.data > i.value : n.data >= i.value) && (s = this._getOrReturnCtx(n, s),
            Mt(s, {
                code: vt.too_big,
                type: "bigint",
                maximum: i.value,
                inclusive: i.inclusive,
                message: i.message
            }),
            a.dirty()) : i.kind === "multipleOf" ? n.data % i.value !== BigInt(0) && (s = this._getOrReturnCtx(n, s),
            Mt(s, {
                code: vt.not_multiple_of,
                multipleOf: i.value,
                message: i.message
            }),
            a.dirty()) : nr.assertNever(i);
        return {
            status: a.value,
            value: n.data
        }
    }
    _getInvalidInput(n) {
        const r = this._getOrReturnCtx(n);
        return Mt(r, {
            code: vt.invalid_type,
            expected: Kt.bigint,
            received: r.parsedType
        }),
        pn
    }
    gte(n, r) {
        return this.setLimit("min", n, !0, tn.toString(r))
    }
    gt(n, r) {
        return this.setLimit("min", n, !1, tn.toString(r))
    }
    lte(n, r) {
        return this.setLimit("max", n, !0, tn.toString(r))
    }
    lt(n, r) {
        return this.setLimit("max", n, !1, tn.toString(r))
    }
    setLimit(n, r, s, a) {
        return new Zc({
            ...this._def,
            checks: [...this._def.checks, {
                kind: n,
                value: r,
                inclusive: s,
                message: tn.toString(a)
            }]
        })
    }
    _addCheck(n) {
        return new Zc({
            ...this._def,
            checks: [...this._def.checks, n]
        })
    }
    positive(n) {
        return this._addCheck({
            kind: "min",
            value: BigInt(0),
            inclusive: !1,
            message: tn.toString(n)
        })
    }
    negative(n) {
        return this._addCheck({
            kind: "max",
            value: BigInt(0),
            inclusive: !1,
            message: tn.toString(n)
        })
    }
    nonpositive(n) {
        return this._addCheck({
            kind: "max",
            value: BigInt(0),
            inclusive: !0,
            message: tn.toString(n)
        })
    }
    nonnegative(n) {
        return this._addCheck({
            kind: "min",
            value: BigInt(0),
            inclusive: !0,
            message: tn.toString(n)
        })
    }
    multipleOf(n, r) {
        return this._addCheck({
            kind: "multipleOf",
            value: n,
            message: tn.toString(r)
        })
    }
    get minValue() {
        let n = null;
        for (const r of this._def.checks)

        return n

class ru extends On {
    _parse(n) {
        if (this._def.coerce && (n.data = new Date(n.data)),
        this._getType(n) !== Kt.date) {
            const i = this._getOrReturnCtx(n);
            return Mt(i, {
                code: vt.invalid_type,
                expected: Kt.date,
                received: i.parsedType
            }),
            pn
        }
        if (Number.isNaN(n.data.getTime())) {
            const i = this._getOrReturnCtx(n);
            return Mt(i, {
                code: vt.invalid_date
            }),
            pn
        }
        const s = new Pa;
        let a;
        for (const i of this._def.checks)
            i.kind === "min" ? n.data.getTime() < i.value && (a = this._getOrReturnCtx(n, a),
            Mt(a, {
                code: vt.too_small,
                message: i.message,
                inclusive: !0,
                exact: !1,
                minimum: i.value,
                type: "date"
            }),
            s.dirty()) : i.kind === "max" ? n.data.getTime() > i.value && (a = this._getOrReturnCtx(n, a),
            Mt(a, {
                code: vt.too_big,
                message: i.message,
                inclusive: !0,
                exact: !1,
                maximum: i.value,
                type: "date"
            }),
            s.dirty()) : nr.assertNever(i);
        return {
            status: s.value,
            value: new Date(n.data.getTime())
        }
    }
    _addCheck(n) {
        return new ru({
            ...this._def,
            checks: [...this._def.checks, n]
        })
    }
    min(n, r) {
        return this._addCheck({
            kind: "min",
            value: n.getTime(),
            message: tn.toString(r)
        })
    }
    max(n, r) {
        return this._addCheck({
            kind: "max",
            value: n.getTime(),
            message: tn.toString(r)
        })
    }
    get minDate() {
        let n = null;
        for (const r of this._def.checks)
            r.kind === "min" && (n === null || r.value > n) && (n = r.value);
        return n != null ? new Date(n) : null
    }
    get maxDate() {
        let n = null;
        for (const r of this._def.checks)
            r.kind === "max" && (n === null || r.value < n) && (n = r.value);
        return n != null ? new Date(n) : null
    }
}

class wo extends On {
    _parse(n) {
        const {ctx: r, status: s} = this._processInputParams(n)
          , a = this._def;
        if (r.parsedType !== Kt.array)
            return Mt(r, {
                code: vt.invalid_type,
                expected: Kt.array,
                received: r.parsedType
            }),
            pn;
        if (a.exactLength !== null) {
            const o = r.data.length > a.exactLength.value
              , l = r.data.length < a.exactLength.value;
            (o || l) && (Mt(r, {
                code: o ? vt.too_big : vt.too_small,
                minimum: l ? a.exactLength.value : void 0,
                maximum: o ? a.exactLength.value : void 0,
                type: "array",
                inclusive: !0,
                exact: !0,
                message: a.exactLength.message
            }),
            s.dirty())
        }
        if (a.minLength !== null && r.data.length < a.minLength.value && (Mt(r, {
            code: vt.too_small,
            minimum: a.minLength.value,
            type: "array",
            inclusive: !0,
            exact: !1,
            message: a.minLength.message
        }),
        s.dirty()),
        a.maxLength !== null && r.data.length > a.maxLength.value && (Mt(r, {
            code: vt.too_big,
            maximum: a.maxLength.value,
            type: "array",
            inclusive: !0,
            exact: !1,
            message: a.maxLength.message
        }),
        s.dirty()),
        r.common.async)
            return Promise.all([...r.data].map( (o, l) => a.type._parseAsync(new cl(r,o,r.path,l)))).then(o => Pa.mergeArray(s, o));
        const i = [...r.data].map( (o, l) => a.type._parseSync(new cl(r,o,r.path,l)));
        return Pa.mergeArray(s, i)
    }
    get element() {
        return this._def.type
    }
    min(n, r) {
        return new wo({
            ...this._def,
            minLength: {
                value: n,
                message: tn.toString(r)
            }
        })
    }
    max(n, r) {
        return new wo({
            ...this._def,
            maxLength: {
                value: n,
                message: tn.toString(r)
            }
        })
    }
    length(n, r) {
        return new wo({
            ...this._def,
            exactLength: {
                value: n,
                message: tn.toString(r)
            }
        })
    }
    nonempty(n) {
        return this.min(1, n)
    }
}

function om(t) {
    if (t instanceof ls) {
        const n = {};
        for (const r in t.shape) {
            const s = t.shape[r];
            n[r] = tl.create(om(s))
        }
        return new ls({
            ...t._def,
            shape: () => n
        })
    } else
        return t instanceof wo ? new wo({
            ...t._def,
            type: om(t.element)
        }) : t instanceof tl ? tl.create(om(t.unwrap())) : t instanceof ed ? ed.create(om(t.unwrap())) : t instanceof dl ? dl.create(t.items.map(n => om(n))) : t
}
class ls extends On {
    constructor() {
        super(...arguments),
        this._cached = null,
        this.nonstrict = this.passthrough,
        this.augment = this.extend
    }
    _getCached() {
        if (this._cached !== null)
            return this._cached;
        const n = this._def.shape()
          , r = nr.objectKeys(n);
        return this._cached = {
            shape: n,
            keys: r
        },
        this._cached
    }
    _parse(n) {
        if (this._getType(n) !== Kt.object) {
            const m = this._getOrReturnCtx(n);
            return Mt(m, {
                code: vt.invalid_type,
                expected: Kt.object,
                received: m.parsedType
            }),
            pn
        }
        const {status: s, ctx: a} = this._processInputParams(n)
          , {shape: i, keys: o} = this._getCached()
          , l = [];
        if (!(this._def.catchall instanceof Yl && this._def.unknownKeys === "strip"))
            for (const m in a.data)
                o.includes(m) || l.push(m);
        const c = [];
        for (const m of o) {
            const u = i[m]
              , h = a.data[m];
            c.push({
                key: {
                    status: "valid",
                    value: m
                },
                value: u._parse(new cl(a,h,a.path,m)),
                alwaysSet: m in a.data
            })
        }
        if (this._def.catchall instanceof Yl) {
            const m = this._def.unknownKeys;
            if (m === "passthrough")
                for (const u of l)
                    c.push({
                        key: {
                            status: "valid",
                            value: u
                        },
                        value: {
                            status: "valid",
                            value: a.data[u]
                        }
                    });
            else if (m === "strict")
                l.length > 0 && (Mt(a, {
                    code: vt.unrecognized_keys,
                    keys: l
                }),
                s.dirty());
            else if (m !== "strip")
                throw new Error("Internal ZodObject error: invalid unknownKeys value.")
        } else {
            const m = this._def.catchall;
            for (const u of l) {
                const h = a.data[u];
                c.push({
                    key: {
                        status: "valid",
                        value: u
                    },
                    value: m._parse(new cl(a,h,a.path,u)),
                    alwaysSet: u in a.data
                })
            }
        }
        return a.common.async ? Promise.resolve().then(async () => {
            const m = [];
            for (const u of c) {
                const h = await u.key
                  , f = await u.value;
                m.push({
                    key: h,
                    value: f,
                    alwaysSet: u.alwaysSet
                })
            }
            return m
        }
        ).then(m => Pa.mergeObjectSync(s, m)) : Pa.mergeObjectSync(s, c)
    }
    get shape() {
        return this._def.shape()
    }
    strict(n) {
        return tn.errToObj,
        new ls({
            ...this._def,
            unknownKeys: "strict",
            ...n !== void 0 ? {
                errorMap: (r, s) => {
                    const a = this._def.errorMap?.(r, s).message ?? s.defaultError;
                    return r.code === "unrecognized_keys" ? {
                        message: tn.errToObj(n).message ?? a
                    } : {
                        message: a
                    }
                }
            } : {}
        })
    }
    strip() {
        return new ls({
            ...this._def,
            unknownKeys: "strip"
        })
    }
    passthrough() {
        return new ls({
            ...this._def,
            unknownKeys: "passthrough"
        })
    }
    extend(n) {
        return new ls({
            ...this._def,
            shape: () => ({
                ...this._def.shape(),
                ...n
            })
        })
    }
    merge(n) {
        return new ls({
            unknownKeys: n._def.unknownKeys,
            catchall: n._def.catchall,
            shape: () => ({
                ...this._def.shape(),
                ...n._def.shape()
            }),
            typeName: gn.ZodObject
        })
    }
    setKey(n, r) {
        return this.augment({
            [n]: r
        })
    }
    catchall(n) {
        return new ls({
            ...this._def,
            catchall: n
        })
    }
    pick(n) {
        const r = {};
        for (const s of nr.objectKeys(n))
            n[s] && this.shape[s] && (r[s] = this.shape[s]);
        return new ls({
            ...this._def,
            shape: () => r
        })
    }
    omit(n) {
        const r = {};
        for (const s of nr.objectKeys(this.shape))
            n[s] || (r[s] = this.shape[s]);
        return new ls({
            ...this._def,
            shape: () => r
        })
    }
    deepPartial() {
        return om(this)
    }
    partial(n) {
        const r = {};
        for (const s of nr.objectKeys(this.shape)) {
            const a = this.shape[s];
            n && !n[s] ? r[s] = a : r[s] = a.optional()
        }
        return new ls({
            ...this._def,
            shape: () => r
        })
    }
    required(n) {
        const r = {};
        for (const s of nr.objectKeys(this.shape))
            if (n && !n[s])
                r[s] = this.shape[s];
            else {
                let i = this.shape[s];
                for (; i instanceof tl; )
                    i = i._def.innerType;
                r[s] = i
            }
        return new ls({
            ...this._def,
            shape: () => r
        })
    }
    keyof() {
        return f8(nr.objectKeys(this.shape))
    }
}

class sf extends On {
    _parse(n) {

          , s = this._def.options;
        function a(i) {
            for (const l of i)
                if (l.result.status === "valid")
                    return l.result;
            for (const l of i)
                if (l.result.status === "dirty")
                    return r.common.issues.push(...l.ctx.common.issues),
                    l.result;
            const o = i.map(l => new yi(l.ctx.common.issues));
            return Mt(r, {
                code: vt.invalid_union,

                    },

                };

                    result: await i._parseAsync({
                        data: r.data,
                        path: r.path,
                        parent: o
                    }),
                    ctx: o
                }

            )).then(a);
        {

                    ...r,

                        issues: []
                    },

                }
                  , u = c._parseSync({

            }),

        }
    }

    }

class Fj extends On {
    _parse(n) {
        const {ctx: r} = this._processInputParams(n);

            return Mt(r, {

            }),

          , a = r.data[s]
          , i = this.optionsMap.get(a);

        }) : i._parseSync({

    }
    static create(n, r, s) {
        const a = new Map;
        for (const i of r) {
            const o = Dl(i.shape[n]);
            if (!o.length)
                throw new Error(`A discriminator value for key \`${n}\` could not be extracted from all schema options`);
            for (const l of o) {

                a.set(l, i)
            }

function yP(t, n) {
    const r = El(t)
      , s = El(n);
    if (t === n)
        return {
            valid: !0,
            data: t
        };
    if (r === Kt.object && s === Kt.object) {
        const a = nr.objectKeys(n)
          , i = nr.objectKeys(t).filter(l => a.indexOf(l) !== -1)
          , o = {
            ...t,
            ...n
        };
        for (const l of i) {
            const c = yP(t[l], n[l]);
            if (!c.valid)
                return {
                    valid: !1
                };
            o[l] = c.data
        }
        return {
            valid: !0,
            data: o
        }
    } else if (r === Kt.array && s === Kt.array) {
        if (t.length !== n.length)
            return {
                valid: !1
            };
        const a = [];
        for (let i = 0; i < t.length; i++) {
            const o = t[i]
              , l = n[i]
              , c = yP(o, l);
            if (!c.valid)
                return {
                    valid: !1
                };
            a.push(c.data)
        }
        return {
            valid: !0,
            data: a
        }
    } else
        return r === Kt.date && s === Kt.date && +t == +n ? {
            valid: !0,
            data: t
        } : {
            valid: !1
        }
}

class dl extends On {
    _parse(n) {
        const {status: r, ctx: s} = this._processInputParams(n);

        })
    }

class su extends On {
    _parse(n) {
        const {status: r, ctx: s} = this._processInputParams(n);
        if (s.parsedType !== Kt.set)
            return Mt(s, {
                code: vt.invalid_type,
                expected: Kt.set,

            code: vt.too_small,

            exact: !1,
            message: a.minSize.message
        }),
        r.dirty()),
        a.maxSize !== null && s.data.size > a.maxSize.value && (Mt(s, {
            code: vt.too_big,
            maximum: a.maxSize.value,

            inclusive: !0,
            exact: !1,
            message: a.maxSize.message
        }),
        r.dirty());
        const i = this._def.valueType;
        function o(c) {
            const m = new Set;
            for (const u of c) {
                if (u.status === "aborted")
                    return pn;
                u.status === "dirty" && r.dirty(),
                m.add(u.value)
            }
            return {
                status: r.value,
                value: m
            }
        }
        const l = [...s.data.values()].map( (c, m) => i._parse(new cl(s,c,s.path,m)));
        return s.common.async ? Promise.all(l).then(c => o(c)) : o(l)
    }

            ...this._def,

                value: n,

            }
        })
    }
    max(n, r) {
        return new su({
            ...this._def,
            maxSize: {
                value: n,
                message: tn.toString(r)
            }
        })
    }
    size(n, r) {
        return this.min(n, r).max(n, r)
    }
    nonempty(n) {
        return this.min(1, n)
    }
}

const dt = Symbol.for("drizzle:entityKind");
function Ds(t, n) {
    if (!t || typeof t != "object")
        return !1;
    if (t instanceof n)
        return !0;
    if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(n, dt))
        throw new Error(`Class "${n.name ?? "<unknown>"}" doesn't look like a Drizzle entity. If this is incorrect and the class is provided by Drizzle, please report this as a bug.`);
    let r = Object.getPrototypeOf(t).constructor;
    if (r)
        for (; r; ) {
            if (dt in r && r[dt] === n[dt])
                return !0;
            r = Object.getPrototypeOf(r)
        }
    return !1
}

function WM(t, n, r) {
    for (let s = n; s < t.length; s++) {
        const a = t[s];
        if (a === "\\") {
            s++;
            continue
        }
        if (a === '"')
            return [t.slice(n, s).replace(/\\/g, ""), s + 1];
        if (!r && (a === "," || a === "}"))
            return [t.slice(n, s).replace(/\\/g, ""), s]
    }
    return [t.slice(n).replace(/\\/g, ""), t.length]
}
function vU(t, n=0) {
    const r = [];
    let s = n
      , a = !1;
    for (; s < t.length; ) {
        const i = t[s];
        if (i === ",") {
            (a || s === n) && r.push(""),
            a = !0,
            s++;
            continue
        }
        if (a = !1,
        i === "\\") {
            s += 2;
            continue
        }
        if (i === '"') {
            const [c,m] = WM(t, s + 1, !0);
            r.push(c),
            s = m;
            continue
        }
        if (i === "}")
            return [r, s + 1];
        if (i === "{") {
            const [c,m] = vU(t, s + 1);
            r.push(c),
            s = m;
            continue
        }
        const [o,l] = WM(t, s, !1);
        r.push(o),
        s = l
    }
    return [r, s]
}
function Fle(t) {
    const [n] = vU(t, 1);
    return n
}
function yU(t) {
    return `{${t.map(n => Array.isArray(n) ? yU(n) : typeof n == "string" ? `"${n.replace(/\\/g, "\\\\").replace(/"/g, '\\"')}"` : `${n}`).join(",")}}`
}

        return this.foreignKeyConfigs.push({
            ref: n,
            actions: r
        }),
        this
    }
    unique(n, r) {
        return this.config.isUnique = !0,
        this.config.uniqueName = n,
        this.config.uniqueType = r?.nulls,
        this
    }
    generatedAlwaysAs(n) {
        return this.config.generated = {
            as: n,
            type: "always",
            mode: "stored"
        },
        this
    }
    buildForeignKeys(n, r) {
        return this.foreignKeyConfigs.map( ({ref: s, actions: a}) => Ele( (i, o) => {
            const l = new Ile( () => {
                const c = i();
                return {
                    columns: [n],
                    foreignColumns: [c]
                }
            }
            );
            return o.onUpdate && l.onUpdate(o.onUpdate),
            o.onDelete && l.onDelete(o.onDelete),
            l.build(r)
        }
        , s, a))
    }
    buildExtraConfigColumn(n) {
        return new Lle(n,this.config)
    }
}

                return new Date;
            const n = new Date(t);
            return isNaN(n.getTime()) ? new Date : n
        }

    }
    ),
    approvalDate: Sr([ge(), Ca(), ql(), Ud()]).transform(t => {

        if (typeof t == "string") {
            const n = new Date(t);
            return isNaN(n.getTime()) ? null : n
        }
        return t
    }
    ).optional(),

function Rhe({open: t, onOpenChange: n, item: r, products: s, uoms: a, users: i, onSubmit: o, isLoading: l}) {
    const [c,m] = v.useState(!1)
      , [u,h] = v.useState(null)
      , [f,x] = v.useState(null)
      , [b,g] = v.useState(!1)
      , y = us({
        resolver: ms(vue),
        defaultValues: {
            productId: "",
            batchNumber: "",
            productionDate: new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0],
            quantity: 0,
            uomId: void 0,
            qualityStatus: "approved",
            machineId: void 0,
            operatorId: void 0,
            inspectedBy: void 0,
            inspectionDate: void 0,
            storageLocation: "",
            remarks: ""
        }
    });
    v.useEffect( () => {
        if (t)
            if (r) {
                const P = C => {
                    if (!C)
                        return new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0];
                    if (typeof C == "string" && /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(C))
                        return C;
                    if (typeof C == "string" && C.includes("T"))
                        return C.split("T")[0];
                    const k = new Date(C);
                    return `${k.getFullYear()}-${String(k.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0")}-${String(k.getDate()).padStart(2, "0")}`
                }
                ;
                y.reset({
                    productId: r.productId || "",
                    batchNumber: r.batchNumber || "",
                    productionDate: P(r.productionDate),
                    quantity: r.quantity || 0,
                    uomId: r.uomId || void 0,
                    qualityStatus: r.qualityStatus || "pending",
                    machineId: r.machineId || void 0,
                    operatorId: r.operatorId || void 0,
                    inspectedBy: r.inspectedBy || void 0,
                    inspectionDate: r.inspectionDate ? P(r.inspectionDate) : void 0,
                    storageLocation: r.storageLocation || "",
                    remarks: r.remarks || ""
                })
            } else
                y.reset({
                    productId: "",
                    batchNumber: "",
                    productionDate: new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0],
                    quantity: 0,
                    uomId: void 0,
                    qualityStatus: "approved",
                    machineId: void 0,
                    operatorId: void 0,
                    inspectedBy: void 0,
                    inspectionDate: void 0,
                    storageLocation: "",
                    remarks: ""
                })
    }
    , [r, t, y]);
    const N = async P => {
        if (r) {
            o(P);
            return
        }
        g(!0);
        try {
            const k = await (await fetch(`/api/finished-goods/check-batch/${encodeURIComponent(P.batchNumber)}`)).json();
            k.exists ? (x(k.existingItem),
            h(P),
            m(!0)) : o(P)
        } catch (C) {
            console.error("Error checking batch number:", C),
            o(P)
        } finally {
            g(!1)
        }
    }
      , S = () => {
        u && o(u),
        m(!1),
        h(null),
        x(null)
    }
      , _ = () => {
        m(!1),
        h(null),
        x(null)
    }
    ;
    return e.jsxs(zt, {
        open: t,
        onOpenChange: n,
        children: [e.jsxs(Lt, {
            className: "sm:max-w-[800px] max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto",
            "data-testid": "dialog-good",
            children: [e.jsxs(Bt, {
                children: [e.jsx(qt, {
                    children: r ? "Edit Finished Good" : "Add Finished Good"
                }), e.jsx(Nn, {
                    children: r ? "Update the finished good details" : "Create a new finished good record"
                })]
            }), e.jsx(ks, {
                ...y,
                children: e.jsxs("form", {
                    onSubmit: y.handleSubmit(N),
                    className: "space-y-4",
                    children: [e.jsxs("div", {
                        className: "grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4",

function qhe(t) {
    const {typeConversion: n, plannedOutput: r, quantityRequired: s} = t;
    if (!n)
        return 0;
    if (n.usableUnits && n.usableUnits > 0)
        return s * r / n.usableUnits;
    if (!n.baseUnitWeight || !n.weightPerDerivedUnit)
        return 0;
    let a = n.baseUnitWeight;
    const i = n.weightPerDerivedUnit;
    a <= 100 && i < 100 && a / i < 10 && (a = a * 1e3);
    const o = a / i
      , l = Math.min(n.lossPercent || 0, 99)
      , c = o * (1 - l / 100);
    return c <= 0 ? 0 : s * r / c
}
function Vhe(t) {
    const {typeConversion: n, plannedOutput: r, quantityRequired: s} = t;
    if (!n)
        return 0;
    const a = n.derivedValuePerBase || n.pcsPerBase;
    if (!a)
        return 0;
    const i = Math.min(n.lossPercent || 0, 99)
      , o = a * (1 - i / 100);
    return o <= 0 ? 0 : s * r / o
}
function zhe(t) {
    const {typeConversion: n, plannedOutput: r} = t;
    if (!n || !n.outputUnitsCovered)
        return 0;
    const s = Math.min(n.lossPercent || 0, 99)
      , a = n.outputUnitsCovered * (1 - s / 100);
    return a <= 0 ? 0 : r / a
}
function Uhe(t) {
    if (!t)
        return "manual";
    const n = t.toLowerCase().trim();
    return n.includes("formula") ? "formula-based" : n.includes("direct") ? "direct-value" : n.includes("output") || n.includes("coverage") ? "output-coverage" : (n.includes("manual"),
    "manual")
}
function Ghe(t, n, r) {
    const {typeConversion: s, plannedOutput: a, quantityRequired: i} = t;
    let o = 0
      , l = ""
      , c = "manual";
    if (!s)
        return o = a * i,
        l = `Basic BOM: ${a} units × ${i} per unit (no type conversion)`,
        c = "manual",
        {
            rawMaterialId: n,
            uomId: r,
            suggestedQuantity: Math.max(0, o),
            calculationBasis: c,
            calculationDetails: l,
            roundedQuantity: Math.ceil(Math.max(0, o))
        };
    const m = Uhe(s.conversionMethod);
    switch (c = m,
    m) {
    case "formula-based":
        o = qhe(t),
        l = `Formula-Based: ${t.plannedOutput} units ÷ ${s.usableUnits || "N/A"} usable units per base`;
        break;
    case "direct-value":
        o = Vhe(t),
        l = `Direct-Value: ${t.plannedOutput} units ÷ ${s.pcsPerBase || s.derivedValuePerBase || "N/A"} pcs per base`;
        break;
    case "output-coverage":
        o = zhe(t),
        l = `Output-Coverage: ${t.plannedOutput} units ÷ ${s.outputUnitsCovered || "N/A"} units covered`;
        break;
    case "manual":
    default:
        o = a * i,
        l = `Manual (BOM-based): ${a} units × ${i} per unit`;
        break
    }
    return isFinite(o) || (o = 0,
    l += " (Invalid: Division by zero or loss >= 100%)"),
    {
        rawMaterialId: n,
        uomId: r,
        suggestedQuantity: Math.max(0, o),
        calculationBasis: c,
        calculationDetails: l,
        roundedQuantity: Math.ceil(Math.max(0, o))
    }
}
function sO(t, n) {
    if (t)
        return t;
    if (!n)
        return "Unknown";
    const r = new Date(n);
    return isNaN(r.getTime()) ? "Unknown" : `LOT-${r.toISOString().slice(0, 10).replace(/-/g, "")}`
}
function Whe(t, n) {
    const r = [];
    let s = t
      , a = 0;
    for (const c of n) {
        if (a += c.currentStock,
        s <= 0) {
            r.push({
                rawMaterialId: c.id,
                materialCode: c.materialCode,
                materialName: c.materialName,
                batchCode: sO(c.batchCode, c.receivedDate),
                receivedDate: c.receivedDate,
                availableStock: c.currentStock,
                allocatedQuantity: 0,
                remainingStock: c.currentStock
            });
            continue
        }
        const m = Math.min(s, c.currentStock);
        s -= m,
        r.push({
            rawMaterialId: c.id,
            materialCode: c.materialCode,
            materialName: c.materialName,
            batchCode: sO(c.batchCode, c.receivedDate),
            receivedDate: c.receivedDate,
            availableStock: c.currentStock,
            allocatedQuantity: m,
            remainingStock: c.currentStock - m
        })
    }
    const i = s > 0
      , o = r.filter(c => c.allocatedQuantity > 0);
    let l = "";
    if (o.length === 0)
        l = "No stock available";
    else if (o.length === 1) {
        const c = o[0];
        l = `${c.batchCode}: ${c.allocatedQuantity.toFixed(2)}`
    } else
        l = o.map(c => `${c.batchCode}: ${c.allocatedQuantity.toFixed(2)}`).join(" + ");
    return i && (l += ` (Short: ${s.toFixed(2)})`),
    {
        allocations: r,
        totalAvailableStock: a,
        insufficientStock: i,
        allocationSummary: l
    }
}
function SG(t, n) {
    const r = new Map;
    if (!n || !Array.isArray(n) || n.length === 0)
        return r;
    for (const s of n) {
        if (!s || !s.bom) {
            console.warn("[BOM Calculation] Skipping invalid BOM item", s);
            continue
        }
        const a = s.effectiveUomId || null
          , i = Number(s.bom.quantityRequired);
        if (isNaN(i) || i < 0) {
            console.warn("[BOM Calculation] Invalid quantityRequired", s.bom);
            continue
        }
        const o = s.availableRawMaterials || [];
        let l = o.length === 0;
        const c = Ghe({
            plannedOutput: t,
            quantityRequired: i,
            typeConversion: s.type || null
        }, "", a)
          , {allocations: m, totalAvailableStock: u, insufficientStock: h, allocationSummary: f} = Whe(c.roundedQuantity, o);
        let x = ""
          , b = !1;
        if (s.bom.rawMaterialId && !s.bom.materialTypeId)
            x = s.bom.rawMaterialId;
        else if (m.length > 0) {
            const N = m.find(S => S.allocatedQuantity > 0);
            N ? (x = N.rawMaterialId,
            b = m.filter(S => S.allocatedQuantity > 0).length > 1) : m[0] && (x = m[0].rawMaterialId)
        }
        const g = s.typeId || s.bom.materialTypeId || s.bom.rawMaterialId || `bom-${r.size}`
          , y = {
            ...c,
            rawMaterialId: x,
            typeId: s.typeId || s.bom.materialTypeId || null,
            typeName: s.type?.name || null,
            baseUnitHint: s.baseUnitHint || s.type?.baseUnit || null,
            availableRawMaterials: o,
            selectionRequired: b,
            outOfStock: l,
            allocations: m,
            totalAvailableStock: u,
            insufficientStock: h,
            allocationSummary: f
        };
        l ? (y.calculationDetails = `No stock available for ${s.type?.name || "this material type"}`,
        y.suggestedQuantity = 0,
        y.roundedQuantity = 0) : h && (y.calculationDetails += ` (Insufficient stock: need ${c.roundedQuantity}, have ${u})`),
        r.set(g, y)
    }
    return r
}
const Khe = or({

function rpe({invoice: t}) {
    const {toast: n} = $t()
      , {data: r=[], isLoading: s} = he({
        queryKey: ["/api/invoice-payments", t.id]
    })
      , a = Ze({
        mutationFn: async u => {
            await Ye("DELETE", `/api/invoice-payments/${u}`)
        }
        ,
        onSuccess: () => {
            Ee.invalidateQueries({
                queryKey: ["/api/invoice-payments"]
            }),
            Ee.invalidateQueries({
                queryKey: ["/api/invoices"]
            }),
            n({
                title: "Success",
                description: "Payment deleted successfully"
            })
        }
        ,
        onError: u => {
            n({
                title: "Error",
                description: u.message,
                variant: "destructive"
            })
        }
    })
      , i = [...r].sort( (u, h) => {
        const f = new Date(u.paymentDate).getTime() - new Date(h.paymentDate).getTime();
        return f !== 0 ? f : new Date(u.createdAt).getTime() - new Date(h.createdAt).getTime()
    }
    );
    let o = 0;
    const l = i.map(u => (o += u.amount,
    {
        ...u,
        runningBalance: t.totalAmount - o
    }))
      , c = r.reduce( (u, h) => u + h.amount, 0)
      , m = t.totalAmount - c;
    return s ? e.jsxs(se, {
        children: [e.jsx($e, {
            children: e.jsx(ze, {
                children: "Payment History"
            })
        }), e.jsx(fe, {
            children: e.jsx("p", {
                className: "text-sm text-muted-foreground",
                children: "Loading..."
            })
        })]
    }) : e.jsxs(se, {
        children: [e.jsx($e, {

            })

                }), e.jsxs("div", {

                    }), e.jsxs("p", {

                        "data-testid": "text-payments-total",

                    })]
                }), e.jsxs("div", {
                    children: [e.jsx("p", {

                        children: "Outstanding"
                    }), e.jsxs("p", {

                        "data-testid": "text-balance-outstanding",
                        children: ["₹", (m / 100).toFixed(2)]
                    })]
                })]
            }), r.length === 0 ? e.jsx("div", {
                className: "text-center py-8 text-muted-foreground",
                children: e.jsx("p", {

                })
            }) : e.jsx("div", {

function ev(t) {

        return "";
    let n = "";
    if (t >= 100 && (n += oO[Math.floor(t / 100)] + " Hundred ",

function lO(t) {

        return "Zero";

      , r = "";

        r += ev(s) + " Lakh ",
        n = n.slice(n.length - 5)

              }

              /* Ensure all table borders print */
              table, th, td {
                border-collapse: collapse !important;
              }

              .items-table th,
              .items-table td {
                border: 1px solid #000 !important;
              }

              .hsn-table th,

              }

              .bill-to {
                border-right: 1px solid #000 !important;
              }

              .company-header {
                border: 1px solid #000 !important;
              }
            }
          </style>
        </head>
        <body>
          ${O("ORIGINAL")}
          ${O("DUPLICATE")}
          ${O("TRIPLICATE")}
        </body>
      </html>
    `;
            console.log("📝 HTML content generated, length:", B.length);
            const Q = /Android|webOS|iPhone|iPad|iPod|BlackBerry|IEMobile|Opera Mini/i.test(navigator.userAgent)
              , ae = new Blob([B],{
                type: "text/html"
            })
              , J = URL.createObjectURL(ae);
            if (console.log("🔗 Blob URL created:", J, "Mobile:", Q),
            Q) {
                console.log("📱 Android/other mobile detected, using blob URL navigation");
                const Z = B.replace("<body>", `<body>
          <div id="mobile-controls" style="position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:12px 16px;background:#1f2937;border-bottom:1px solid #374151;z-index:100000;gap:12px;">
            <button onclick="history.back()" style="padding:10px 16px;background:#3b82f6;color:white;border:none;border-radius:8px;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;">← Back</button>
            <div style="color:white;font-size:13px;text-align:center;flex:1;">Tap <strong>⋮ Menu</strong> → <strong>Print</strong></div>
          </div>
          <div style="padding-top:56px;">`).replace("</body>", "</div></body>")
                  , F = new Blob([Z],{
                    type: "text/html"
                })
                  , D = URL.createObjectURL(F);
                window.location.href = D
            } else {
                const Z = window.open(J, "_blank");
                if (console.log("🪟 Window.open result:", Z),
                !Z) {
                    console.log("❌ Failed to open window - popup blocked"),
                    n({
                        title: "Unable to Open Print Preview",
                        description: "Please check your browser settings and allow popups for this site.",
                        variant: "destructive"
                    }),
                    URL.revokeObjectURL(J);
                    return
                }
                console.log("✅ Print window opened successfully!"),
                setTimeout( () => {
                    console.log("🧹 Cleaning up blob URL"),
                    URL.revokeObjectURL(J)
                }
                , 1e3)
            }
        } catch (_) {
            console.error("❌ Print error:", _),
            n({
                title: "Print Error",
                description: `Failed to generate print: ${_instanceof Error ? _.message : "Unknown error"}`,
                variant: "destructive"
            })
        }
    }
    ;
    return e.jsxs("div", {
        className: "flex items-center gap-2",
        children: [e.jsxs(W, {
            variant: "default",
            size: "sm",
            onClick: S,
            disabled: h || r.length === 0,
            "data-testid": `button-print-invoice-${t.id}`,
            className: "gap-2",
            children: [e.jsx(Dr, {
                className: "w-4 h-4"
            }), h ? "Loading..." : "Print / Download PDF"]
        }), e.jsx("span", {
            className: "text-xs text-muted-foreground",
            children: h ? "Preparing invoice..." : "(Click to print or save as PDF)"
        })]
    })
}

const Lpe = "modulepreload"
  , Bpe = function(t) {
    return "/" + t
}
  , $O = {}
  , Yi = function(n, r, s) {
    let a = Promise.resolve();
    if (r && r.length > 0) {
        let m = function(u) {
            return Promise.all(u.map(h => Promise.resolve(h).then(f => ({
                status: "fulfilled",
                value: f
            }), f => ({
                status: "rejected",
                reason: f
            }))))
        };
        var o = m;
        document.getElementsByTagName("link");
        const l = document.querySelector("meta[property=csp-nonce]")
          , c = l?.nonce || l?.getAttribute("nonce");
        a = m(r.map(u => {
            if (u = Bpe(u),
            u in $O)
                return;
            $O[u] = !0;
            const h = u.endsWith(".css")
              , f = h ? '[rel="stylesheet"]' : "";
            if (document.querySelector(`link[href="${u}"]${f}`))
                return;
            const x = document.createElement("link");
            if (x.rel = h ? "stylesheet" : Lpe,
            h || (x.as = "script"),
            x.crossOrigin = "",
            x.href = u,
            c && x.setAttribute("nonce", c),
            document.head.appendChild(x),
            h)
                return new Promise( (b, g) => {
                    x.addEventListener("load", b),
                    x.addEventListener("error", () => g(new Error(`Unable to preload CSS for ${u}`)))
                }
                )
        }
        ))
    }
    function i(l) {
        const c = new Event("vite:preloadError",{
            cancelable: !0
        });
        if (c.payload = l,
        window.dispatchEvent(c),
        !c.defaultPrevented)
            throw l
    }
    return a.then(l => {
        for (const c of l || [])
            c.status === "rejected" && i(c.reason);
        return n().catch(i)
    }
    )
};

const L2e = or({
    machineId: ge().min(1, "Machine is required"),
    assignedUserId: ge().min(1, "User is required"),
    scheduledStartTime: ge().min(1, "Start time is required"),
    reminderBeforeMinutes: $n.number().min(5).max(480),
    productionDate: ge().regex(/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/, "Invalid date format"),
    shift: ge().optional(),
    notes: ge().optional(),
    whatsappEnabled: au().default(!0),
    emailEnabled: au().default(!0)
});
function LK() {
    const {toast: t} = $t()
      , {logoutMutation: n} = un()
      , {hasPermission: r} = _r()
      , s = r("machine_startup_reminders", "create");
    r("machine_startup_reminders", "edit");
    const a = r("machine_startup_reminders", "delete")
      , [i,o] = v.useState(!1)
      , [l,c] = v.useState(!1)
      , [m,u] = v.useState(null)
      , {data: h=[], isLoading: f} = he({
        queryKey: ["/api/machine-startup-tasks"]
    })
      , {data: x=[]} = he({
        queryKey: ["/api/machines"]
    })
      , {data: b=[]} = he({
        queryKey: ["/api/users"]
    })
      , g = us({
        resolver: ms(L2e),
        defaultValues: {
            machineId: "",
            assignedUserId: "",
            scheduledStartTime: "",
            reminderBeforeMinutes: 30,
            productionDate: "",
            shift: "",
            notes: "",
            whatsappEnabled: !0,
            emailEnabled: !0
        }
    });
    v.useEffect( () => {
        const w = g.watch( (E, {name: T}) => {
            if (T === "machineId" && E.machineId) {
                const I = x.find(R => R.id === E.machineId);
                I && I.warmupTimeMinutes && g.setValue("reminderBeforeMinutes", I.warmupTimeMinutes)
            }
        }
        );
        return () => w.unsubscribe()
    }
    , [x, g]);
    const y = Ze({
        mutationFn: async w => await Ye("POST", "/api/machine-startup-tasks", w),
        onSuccess: () => {
            Ee.invalidateQueries({
                queryKey: ["/api/machine-startup-tasks"]
            }),
            t({
                title: "Success",
                description: "Startup reminder created successfully"
            }),
            o(!1),
            g.reset()
        }
        ,
        onError: w => {
            t({
                variant: "destructive",
                title: "Error",
                description: w.message || "Failed to create startup reminder"
            })
        }
    })
      , N = Ze({
        mutationFn: async w => await Ye("DELETE", `/api/machine-startup-tasks/${w}`),
        onSuccess: () => {
            Ee.invalidateQueries({
                queryKey: ["/api/machine-startup-tasks"]
            }),
            t({
                title: "Success",
                description: "Startup reminder deleted"
            })
        }
        ,
        onError: w => {
            t({
                variant: "destructive",
                title: "Error",
                description: w.message || "Failed to delete startup reminder"
            })
        }
    })
      , S = w => {
        y.mutate(w)
    }
      , _ = w => {
        confirm("Are you sure you want to delete this startup reminder?") && N.mutate(w)
    }
      , P = w => {
        switch (w) {
        case "pending":
            return e.jsxs(Te, {
                variant: "secondary",
                "data-testid": `status-${w}`,
                children: [e.jsx(Za, {
                    className: "w-3 h-3 mr-1"
                }), "Pending"]
            });
        case "notified":
            return e.jsxs(Te, {
                variant: "default",
                "data-testid": `status-${w}`,
                children: [e.jsx(Gc, {
                    className: "w-3 h-3 mr-1"
                }), "Notified"]
            });
        case "completed":
            return e.jsxs(Te, {
                variant: "default",
                className: "bg-green-600",
                "data-testid": `status-${w}`,
                children: [e.jsx(xs, {
                    className: "w-3 h-3 mr-1"
                }), "Completed"]
            });
        case "cancelled":
            return e.jsxs(Te, {
                variant: "destructive",
                "data-testid": `status-${w}`,
                children: [e.jsx(cs, {
                    className: "w-3 h-3 mr-1"
                }), "Cancelled"]
            });
        default:
            return e.jsx(Te, {
                "data-testid": `status-${w}`,
                children: w
            })

async function CL(t, n, r) {
    const s = await fetch("/api/gst-reports", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: {
            "Content-Type": "application/json"
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
            periodType: t,
            month: n,
            year: r
        }),
        credentials: "include"
    });
    if (!s.ok) {
        const a = await s.json().catch( () => ({
            message: "Failed to fetch GST report data"
        }));
        throw new Error(a.message || "Failed to fetch GST report data")
    }
    return s.json()
}
function Jr(t) {
    return Number((t / 100).toFixed(2))
}
function D_(t, n) {
    return t === 0 ? 0 : Number((n / t * 100).toFixed(2))
}
function Ic(t) {
    const n = new Date(t)
      , r = n.getDate().toString().padStart(2, "0")
      , s = (n.getMonth() + 1).toString().padStart(2, "0")
      , a = n.getFullYear();
    return `${r}-${s}-${a}`
}
function _L(t, n, r, s, a, i) {

      , u = []
      , h = [];
    t.forEach(x => {
        const b = Jr(x.totalAmount)
          , g = Jr(x.subtotal)
          , y = Jr(x.cgstAmount)
          , N = Jr(x.sgstAmount)
          , S = Jr(x.igstAmount)
          , _ = Jr(x.cessAmount)
          , P = y + N + S
          , C = D_(g, P)
          , k = x.sellerState === x.buyerState
          , w = x.buyerGstin && x.buyerGstin.length === 15;
        if (!w && x.placeOfSupply && (x.placeOfSupply.toLowerCase().includes("export") || x.buyerState === "EXPORT")) {
            const T = {
                exp_typ: "WPAY",
                inv: [{

                    idt: new Date(x.invoiceDate).toISOString().split("T")[0],
                    val: b,
                    txval: g,
                    rt: C,
                    iamt: 0
                }]
            };
            m.push(T)
        } else if (w) {
            const T = {
                ctin: x.buyerGstin || "",
                inv: [{
                    inum: x.invoiceNumber,
                    idt: new Date(x.invoiceDate).toISOString().split("T")[0],

                    csamt: _,
                    camt: y,
                    samt: N,
                    iamt: S
                }]
            };
            o.push(T)
        } else if (b > 25e4) {
            const T = {

                inv: [{

                    idt: new Date(x.invoiceDate).toISOString().split("T")[0],
                    val: b,

                    rt: C,
                    csamt: _,
                    iamt: S || P
                }]
            };

                typ: k ? "OE" : "E",
                txval: g,
                rt: C,
                csamt: _,
                camt: y,
                samt: N,
                iamt: S
            };
            c.push(T)
        }
    }
    );
    const f = (s || []).map(x => ({

    }));

              , w = D_(N, k);
            if (g.buyerGstin && g.buyerGstin.length === 15) {

                }

                x.has(I) || x.set(I, []),
                x.get(I).push(T)
            } else {

function PL(t, n, r, s, a) {
    let i = 0
      , o = 0
      , l = 0
      , c = 0
      , m = 0;
    t.forEach(S => {
        i += Jr(S.subtotal),
        o += Jr(S.igstAmount),
        l += Jr(S.cgstAmount),
        c += Jr(S.sgstAmount),
        m += Jr(S.cessAmount)
    }
    );
    const u = ["processing_charges", "job_work_charges", "freight_charges", "quality_premium", "material_conversion"]
      , h = ["defective_goods", "short_receipt", "quality_rejection", "price_dispute"];
    let f = 0
      , x = 0
      , b = 0
      , g = 0
      , y = 0
      , N = 0;
    return a && a.forEach( ({vendorDebitNote: S}) => {
        const _ = S.reason
          , P = Jr(S.igstAmount)
          , C = Jr(S.cgstAmount)
          , k = Jr(S.sgstAmount);
        u.includes(_) ? (f += P,
        x += C,
        b += k) : h.includes(_) && (g += P,
        y += C,
        N += k)
    }
    ),
    {
        gstin: s,
        ret_period: r,
        sup_details: {
            osup_det: {
                txval: Number(i.toFixed(2)),
                iamt: Number(o.toFixed(2)),
                camt: Number(l.toFixed(2)),
                samt: Number(c.toFixed(2)),
                csamt: Number(m.toFixed(2))
            }
        },
        itc_elg: {
            itc_avl: {
                iamt: Number(f.toFixed(2)),
                camt: Number(x.toFixed(2)),
                samt: Number(b.toFixed(2))
            },
            itc_rev: {
                iamt: Number(g.toFixed(2)),
                camt: Number(y.toFixed(2)),
                samt: Number(N.toFixed(2))
            }
        }
    }
}
function B2e(t, n, r, s) {
    return t.filter(a => {
        const i = new Date(a.invoiceDate)
          , o = i.getFullYear()
          , l = i.getMonth() + 1;
        if (s === "monthly")
            return o === r && l === n;
        if (s === "quarterly") {
            const c = n
              , m = c - 2
              , u = c;
            return o === r && l >= m && l <= u
        } else
            return o === r
    }
    )
}
function E_(t, n) {
    return `${t.toString().padStart(2, "0")}${n}`
}
function kL(t, n, r) {
    const s = JSON.stringify(t, null, 2)
      , a = new Blob([s],{
        type: "application/json"
    })
      , i = URL.createObjectURL(a)
      , o = document.createElement("a");
    o.href = i,
    o.download = `${n}_${r}.json`,
    document.body.appendChild(o),
    o.click(),
    document.body.removeChild(o),
    URL.revokeObjectURL(i)
}

function Ir(t) {
    return (t / 100).toFixed(2)
}
function Rl(t) {
    try {
        return be(new Date(t), "dd-MMM-yyyy")
    } catch {
        return t
    }
}
async function z2e(t, n, r, s) {
    const a = new URLSearchParams;
    t && a.append("startDate", t),
    n && a.append("endDate", n),
    r && a.append("status", r),
    s && a.append("payeeType", s);
    const i = await fetch(`/api/reports/expenses?${a.toString()}`, {
        credentials: "include"
    });
    if (!i.ok)
        throw new Error("Failed to fetch expense report");
    return i.json()
}

function tAe({creditNote: t}) {
    const {data: n=[]} = he({
        queryKey: ["/api/credit-note-items", t.id],
        queryFn: async () => {
            const c = await fetch(`/api/credit-note-items?creditNoteId=${t.id}`, {
                credentials: "include"
            });

            itemDifferences: E,

    }
    , [y, h, a, i, o, l])
      , S = async C => {

                    "Content-Type": "application/json"
                },

                message: k instanceof Error ? k.message : "Failed to create credit note"

        } finally {
            u(!1)
        }

const jAe = or({
    reason: pa(["quantity_increase", "price_increase", "additional_charges", "other"], {
        required_error: "Please select a reason"
    }),
    customReason: ge().optional(),
    notes: ge().optional(),
    items: Ja(or({
        invoiceItemId: ge(),
        originalQuantity: St(),
        originalUnitPrice: St(),
        newQuantity: $n.number().min(0, "Quantity must be 0 or more"),
        newUnitPrice: $n.number().min(0, "Price must be 0 or more")
    }))
});
function bAe({open: t, onOpenChange: n, invoiceId: r, invoiceNumber: s, invoiceItems: a, cgstRate: i, sgstRate: o, igstRate: l, onSuccess: c}) {

      , x = us({
        resolver: ms(jAe),
        defaultValues: {
            reason: "quantity_increase",
            notes: "",
            items: []
        }
    });
    v.useEffect( () => {
        t && h?.items && x.reset({
            reason: "quantity_increase",
            notes: "",
            items: h.items.map(C => ({
                invoiceItemId: C.id,
                originalQuantity: C.originalQuantity,
                originalUnitPrice: C.originalUnitPrice,
                newQuantity: C.remainingQuantity,
                newUnitPrice: C.currentUnitPrice || C.originalUnitPrice
            }))
        })
    }
    , [t, h, x]);
    const b = x.watch("reason")
      , g = x.watch("items")

        p: C.newUnitPrice
    })))

        let C = 0
          , k = 0
          , w = 0

          , T = 0;
        const I = [];
        g.forEach( (O, B) => {
            const Q = h?.items[B];
            if (!Q)
                return;
            const ae = Q.remainingQuantity
              , J = Q.currentUnitPrice || Q.originalUnitPrice
              , Z = Number(O.newQuantity) || 0
              , F = Number(O.newUnitPrice) || 0
              , D = ae * J
              , G = Z * F
              , ce = G - D;
            if (C += D,
            k += G,
            ce > 0) {
                const ee = Q.cgstRate || 0
                  , q = Q.sgstRate || 0
                  , X = Q.igstRate || 0
                  , K = Math.round(ce * ee / 1e4)
                  , te = Math.round(ce * q / 1e4)
                  , le = Math.round(ce * X / 1e4);
                w += K,
                E += te,
                T += le,
                I.push({
                    invoiceItemId: O.invoiceItemId,
                    productName: Q.productName || a[B]?.description || "Unknown",
                    originalAmount: D,
                    newAmount: G,
                    difference: ce,
                    additionalQuantity: Z - ae > 0 ? Z - ae : 0,
                    priceIncrease: F - J > 0 ? F - J : 0,
                    cgstDifference: K,
                    sgstDifference: te,
                    igstDifference: le
                })
            }
        }
        );
        const R = k - C
          , M = R + w + E + T
          , L = k < C;
        return {
            totalOriginal: C,
            totalNew: k,
            subtotalDifference: R,
            cgstDifference: w,
            sgstDifference: E,
            igstDifference: T,
            grandTotalDifference: M,
            itemDifferences: I,
            hasChanges: R > 0,
            isDecreasing: L
        }
    }
    , [y, h, a])
      , S = async C => {
        if (!N.hasChanges) {
            N.isDecreasing ? x.setError("root", {
                type: "manual",
                message: "Debit notes can only INCREASE amounts. To reduce quantities or prices, use 'Correct & Credit' instead."
            }) : x.setError("root", {
                type: "manual",
                message: "No changes detected. Please increase quantities or prices to create a debit note."
            });
            return
        }
        u(!0);
        try {
            const k = await fetch("/api/debit-notes/correct-and-debit", {
                method: "POST",
                headers: {
                    "Content-Type": "application/json"
                },
                credentials: "include",
                body: JSON.stringify({
                    invoiceId: r,
                    reason: C.reason,
                    customReason: C.customReason,
                    notes: C.notes,
                    items: C.items.map(E => ({
                        invoiceItemId: E.invoiceItemId,
                        originalQuantity: E.originalQuantity,
                        originalUnitPrice: E.originalUnitPrice,
                        newQuantity: E.newQuantity,
                        newUnitPrice: E.newUnitPrice
                    }))
                })
            });
            if (!k.ok) {
                const E = await k.json();
                throw new Error(E.message || "Failed to create debit note")
            }
            const w = await k.json();
            c?.(w.debitNoteNumber),
            n(!1)
        } catch (k) {
            x.setError("root", {
                type: "manual",
                message: k instanceof Error ? k.message : "Failed to create debit note"
            })
        } finally {
            u(!1)
        }
    }
      , _ = C => `₹${(C / 100).toFixed(2)}`
      , P = h?.summary && (h.summary.creditNoteCount > 0 || h.summary.debitNoteCount > 0);

        open: t,

      , [i,o] = v.useState(null)
      , [l,c] = v.useState(null)

      , w = Ze({
        mutationFn: async O => {
            const B = await fetch("/api/import-vyapaar", {
                method: "POST",
                body: O,
                credentials: "include"
            });
            if (!B.ok) {
                let ae = "Import failed";
                try {
                    ae = (await B.json()).message || ae
                } catch (J) {
                    console.error("Failed to parse error response:", J)
                }
                throw new Error(ae)
            }
            const Q = await B.json();
            if (!Q.success)
                throw new Error(Q.message || "Import failed");
            return Q
        }
        ,
        onSuccess: O => {
            u(O),
            f(!0);

            Ee.invalidateQueries({

            Ee.invalidateQueries({

function EL(t) {
    if (!t)
        return {
            status: "none",
            daysRemaining: null,
            label: "No expiry set"
        };
    const n = new Date;
    n.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
    const r = new Date(t);
    r.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
    const s = r.getTime() - n.getTime()
      , a = Math.ceil(s / (1e3 * 60 * 60 * 24));
    return a < 0 ? {
        status: "expired",
        daysRemaining: a,
        label: "Expired"
    } : a <= 7 ? {
        status: "urgent",
        daysRemaining: a,
        label: `${a} day${a !== 1 ? "s" : ""} left`
    } : a <= 30 ? {
        status: "warning",
        daysRemaining: a,
        label: `${a} days left`
    } : {
        status: "ok",
        daysRemaining: a,
        label: `${a} days left`
    }
}

                credentials: "include"
            });
            if (!b.ok)
                throw new Error("Failed to fetch expense items");

        }
    })
      , {data: s=[], isLoading: a} = he({
        queryKey: ["/api/expense-categories"]
    })

function Vn(t) {
    return new Intl.NumberFormat("en-IN",{
        style: "currency",
        currency: "INR",
        minimumFractionDigits: 0,
        maximumFractionDigits: 2
    }).format(t)
}

const M_ = t => new Intl.NumberFormat("en-IN",{
    style: "currency",
    currency: "INR",
    minimumFractionDigits: 2
}).format(t / 100)
  , fv = t => (t / 100).toFixed(2)
  , OAe = t => {
    const n = ["", "One", "Two", "Three", "Four", "Five", "Six", "Seven", "Eight", "Nine", "Ten", "Eleven", "Twelve", "Thirteen", "Fourteen", "Fifteen", "Sixteen", "Seventeen", "Eighteen", "Nineteen"]
      , r = ["", "", "Twenty", "Thirty", "Forty", "Fifty", "Sixty", "Seventy", "Eighty", "Ninety"];
    if (t === 0)
        return "Zero";
    const s = l => l < 20 ? n[l] : l < 100 ? r[Math.floor(l / 10)] + (l % 10 ? " " + n[l % 10] : "") : l < 1e3 ? n[Math.floor(l / 100)] + " Hundred" + (l % 100 ? " " + s(l % 100) : "") : l < 1e5 ? s(Math.floor(l / 1e3)) + " Thousand" + (l % 1e3 ? " " + s(l % 1e3) : "") : l < 1e7 ? s(Math.floor(l / 1e5)) + " Lakh" + (l % 1e5 ? " " + s(l % 1e5) : "") : s(Math.floor(l / 1e7)) + " Crore" + (l % 1e7 ? " " + s(l % 1e7) : "")
      , a = Math.floor(t)
      , i = Math.round((t - a) * 100);
    let o = s(a) + " Rupees";
    return i > 0 && (o += " and " + s(i) + " Paise"),
    o + " Only"
}

function zAe({open: t, onOpenChange: n, debitNote: r, onSuccess: s}) {

      , [i,o] = v.useState("invoice")
      , [l,c] = v.useState({})
      , [m,u] = v.useState("")
      , [h,f] = v.useState(!1)
      , x = r.grandTotal - r.settledAmount;
    v.useEffect( () => {
        t && (c({}),
        u(""))
    }
    , [t]);

        enabled: t && !!r.vendorId
    })
      , {data: y=[], isLoading: N} = he({

        mutationFn: async T => (await Ye("POST", `/api/vendor-debit-notes/${r.id}/adjustments`, T)).json()
    })
      , _ = T => `₹${(T / 100).toFixed(2)}`
      , P = Object.values(l).reduce( (T, I) => T + I.amount, 0)
      , C = x - P
      , k = (T, I, R, M) => {
        c(L => {
            if (L[T]) {
                const {[T]: O, ...B} = L;
                return B
            } else {
                const O = Math.min(R, C);
                return {
                    ...L,

                        amount: O > 0 ? O : 0,
                        maxAmount: R,
                        type: I,

                    }

                return R;

                }

        }

    }
      , E = async () => {

        }

}

function xTe() {
    const {toast: t} = $t()
      , n = Ze({
        mutationFn: async r => await Ye("POST", "/api/auth/set-role", {
            role: r
        }),
        onSuccess: () => {
            Ee.invalidateQueries({
                queryKey: ["/api/auth/user"]
            }),
            t({
                title: "Role assigned",
                description: "Your role has been assigned successfully."
            })
        }
        ,
        onError: r => {
            if (fAe(r)) {
                t({
                    title: "Unauthorized",
                    description: "You are logged out. Logging in again...",
                    variant: "destructive"
                }),
                setTimeout( () => {
                    window.location.href = "/api/login"
                }
                , 500);
                return
            }
            t({
                title: "Error",
                description: "Failed to assign role. Please try again.",
                variant: "destructive"
            })
        }
    });
    return e.jsx(vte, {
        onRoleSelect: r => {
            n.mutate(r)
        }
    })
}
function gTe() {

    if (n)
        return e.jsx("div", {

                }), e.jsx("p", {
                    className: "text-muted-foreground",
                    children: "Loading..."
                })]
            })
        });
    if (!t?.role)
        return e.jsx(xTe, {});

    return r === "operator" ? e.jsx(uTe, {}) : r === "reviewer" ? e.jsx(mTe, {}) : r === "manager" ? e.jsx(hTe, {}) : r === "admin" ? e.jsx(fTe, {}) : e.jsx(pTe, {
        roleName: t.role
    })
}

function CTe(t, n) {
    const r = STe[t];
    if (!r)
        return !1;
    if (t === "reports") {
        if (n.find(o => o.screenKey === "reports")?.canView === !0)
            return !0;
        const i = ["report_gatepasses", "report_invoices", "report_issuances", "report_purchase_orders", "report_maintenance", "report_expenses", "report_cash_register", "report_gst", "report_payments", "report_finished_goods", "report_monthly_sales"];
        return n.some(o => i.includes(o.screenKey) && o.canView === !0)
    }
    return n.find(a => a.screenKey === r)?.canView === !0
}

}
